chapter.verse: Ka ta aw, kong thuhilhte mangngilh kei in la, kong thugente phawk tawntung in.
Kong thuhilhte in na khan’ hong sausak ding a, nang hong daupai sak ding hi.
Thumanna leh cihtakna khahsuah ngei kei in la, na ngawng-ah tuate ok in, na lungtang tungah gelh in.
Tua hi leh, Pasian leh mite mai-ah maipha ngahin na ma vang ding hi.
Na lungsim khempeuh tawh Topa muang in la, nang’ theihna suang kei in.
Na hihna khempeuh ah amah phawk in; tua hi leh lampi maan hong lak ding hi.
Nangmah mah a pilin kingaihsun tawm kei in la, Topa zahtakin, a sia pel in.
Tua hi leh, nang adingin damna zatui tawh kibang ding a, na meimate damsakin, na natnate daisak ding hi.
Na neihsate leh na anpalte tawh Topa zahtak in.
Tua hi leh, na ansaalte an tawh kidim ding a, a beel dimleetin leenggahzu na nei ding hi.
Ka ta aw, Topa ’ hong thuhilhna lim takin ngai in la, hong tainate thudon in.
Bang hang hiam cih leh, pa in a pahtak a tapa a thuhilh bangin, Topa in a it mite a thuhilh hi.
Pilna nei-in, thu a thei mipa in, a lungdam mi ahi hi.
Pilna nei leng, ngun sangin hoihzaw a, kham sangin manphazaw hi.
Pilna in a manphapen suangmanpha nangawn sangin manphazaw a, mihingte’ deih theih na lakah tehpih theih ding om lo hi.
Pilna in hong khan’ sausak a, hauhna leh pahtawina zong hong pia hi.
Pilna in nuntakna hong nuamsak a, lungmuang takin hong omsak den hi.
Pilna a nei mite a lungdam mi hi a, pilna a neite in nuntakna singkung tawh kibang hi.
Topa in a pilna tawh leitung bawl a, a theihtelna tawh vantung bawl hi.
Ama pilna in guntuite luangsak a, meiite in leitungah guahzu sak hi.
Ka ta aw, pilna leh thu ngaihsut theihna len tawntung in la, cik mah ciangin khahsuah ngei kei in.
Tuate in nang adingin nuntakna hi ding a, na hoih nadingin kizepna hi ding hi.
Tua hi leh, lungmuang takin na nungta ding a, puk nading thu bangmah om lo ding hi.
Launa om loin nuam takin na lum ding a, zan tawntung lungmuang takin na ihmu thei ding hi.
Migilote tungah huihpi bangin siatna a tun’ ciangin, nang na lunghihmawh nading om lo ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in a muanhuai-in nang hong kem ding a, siatna hong tuak sak lo ding hi.
Nangma hih zawh ding thu ahih nak leh, midangte’ kitaangsapna huh tawntung in,
Na vaihawmsak theih pah ding ahih nak leh, zing ciangin hong pai kik in, ci-in a hun sotto kei in.
Nang hong muangin na nai-ah hong teeng na vengpa, gim a ngah nading bangmah vaihawm kei in.
Nang tungah bangmah siatna a hong bawl lo, mi khatpeuh tawh thu om lopi-in kimawktot kei in.
A ngongtat thei mite eng kha kei in la, amau’ gamtat bangin gamta kha kei in.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in a sia-a gamtate mudah a, thuman mite bek a pawlpih dingin la hi.
Topa in migilote’ inn sung samsia a, thuman mite’ inn sung thupha pia hi.
Amah in mi kihisakte bang mahin sim lo a, a kiniamkhiatte tungah maipha pia hi.
Mipilte in minphatna leh pahtawina ngah ding a, mihaite in maizumna leh mindaina ngah ding uh hi.
